{
  "name": "usage-pacer",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Pace Claude Code's weekly usage limit day by day for the projects you choose: a side project is paused once the account runs ahead of its daily share, so your main work keeps its budget",
  "author": {
    "name": "ref",
    "url": "https://github.com/ref"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/ref/claude/tree/master/plugins/usage-pacer",
  "repository": "https://github.com/ref/claude",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "mod",
    "usage",
    "rate-limits",
    "weekly-limit",
    "budget"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "daily_percent": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Daily share of the weekly limit (%)",
      "description": "Paced projects may use at most day_of_week * this many percent of the 7-day window. 14.3 = the week split evenly; lower it to keep more for unpaced work.",
      "default": 14.3,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 100
    },
    "block_tools": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Also stop a running turn",
      "description": "When the limit is crossed mid-turn, deny further tool calls and abort the turn. Off: only new prompts are blocked.",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
